title: Booking Rules for Alignment Services & Plans Appointments
content:
**Rule.** Appointments under Alignment Services & Plans are booked only on a plan that is in force: the plan must be in status active when an appointment is booked. The plan's own system record decides this, for the plan the appointment is booked on.

**Slot terms.** The slot must start at least the line's minimum lead time in hours after the booking, and no more than the line's booking horizon in calendar days after the booking date. It is booked for the line's bay time in minutes, and for an alignment type the line includes.

**Moving an appointment.** Moving an appointment books a new appointment with the new slot. The bookings made for the same visit — the original booking and each reschedule — may not exceed one plus the number of moves the line allows.

**Late arrival.** A customer who has not arrived by the line's late-release minutes after the slot start loses the slot, and the line's missed-appointment fee is charged for it.

**Price.** Booking does not decide the price. Whether the visit is included, charged at the member early price, or a free readjustment is decided on the visit date under the alignment service rules and the readjustment guarantee of this product.

### Condition — judgement — result

| Condition at booking | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Plan status is active | in force | the appointment may be booked |
| Plan status is expired, cancelled or vehicle retired | not in force | no appointment is booked on it |
| Requested alignment type is not one the line includes | outside the line | no appointment for that type |
| A further move would make the bookings for one visit exceed one plus the allowed moves | over the limit | the move is not booked |

*Hypothetical:* on a line allowing 2 moves, an original booking moved twice is a chain of three bookings, which is the most one visit may have.
